t.zh: 新元件，符号 ∧：两个输入都为真，才输出真。
t.en: The new part , written ∧, outputs true only when both inputs are true.

brief.zh: 接一块电路，算出「下雨，并且不刮风」在每一行的真值。
brief.en: Wire a board that works out the value of “it rains and it is not windy” on every row.

hint.zh: 两件事要同时成立：「下雨」和「不刮风」。
hint.en: Two things must hold at once: “it rains” and “it is not windy”.
